bills.title: The Forest (Conservation) Amendment Bill, 2023
bills.highlights_text: Amends the Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980 to narrow which land counts as forest, exempts land near borders and small roadside amenities, and allows zoos, safaris and eco-tourism in forest land.
bills.key_issues_text: PRS notes the exclusions may conflict with a 1996 Supreme Court judgement and could affect forest cover and biodiversity in north-eastern states.
bills.rationale: This is a sample seed row, not a live score — it will be replaced once the scraper/scorer runs for the first time. It illustrates roughly how a forest-law amendment with narrowed protections might score: strong on scale (national forest law) and moderate on enforceability, but low on mitigation substance since it narrows rather than strengthens protections.
